union_of_b_c_d.description: Flag a revision if any of B, C, or D flags it; derived from the three recorded responses without another model call.

majority_of_b_c_d.description: Flag a revision if at least two of B, C, or D flag it.

recommendation.reason: It improved recall from 10% to 50% while retaining 100% precision and zero clean false positives on this sample.
recommendation.higher_recall_option: Use the union of independent B/C/D runs when 60% recall is worth an 18.18% clean false-positive rate and roughly triple inference cost.
recommendation.validation_warning: These prompts were selected on the same 21-item sample used for scoring. Treat the gain as development-set evidence and confirm it on a separately frozen holdout before changing production routing.

harness_note: Antigravity duplicated JSON in its textual response for A-C; scoring used the schema-validated structured_output field from the successful CLI envelope. No model reruns were used to repair parsing.
